narrative.overview: Dot Field is a canvas-first creative tool with one floating, continuous glass panel. The dark canvas stays dominant; the controls feel like a precise translucent instrument suspended above it. White information, restrained violet-to-indigo accents and fine white-alpha rules carry the hierarchy. The approved visual authority is Aura component 8442B (https://www.aura.build/component/8442B), preserved locally in /Users/sergeymaximov/.codex/attachments/03183e65-c732-46be-b325-4f80bdfdb9f4/Pasted text.txt. Its glass material and violet gradients are intentional exceptions to generic warnings against glassmorphism or purple gradients.
keyCharacteristics: One floating glass shell over an uninterrupted dark canvas.
Bricolage Grotesque throughout, with compact labels and tabular values.
Violet/indigo reserved for interactive emphasis; white and cool gray carry content.
Flat internal sections separated by hairlines, never nested cards.
Persistent export actions and a mobile bottom sheet sized for real touch use.

rules.name: The Aura Exception Rule
rules.body: The approved Aura reference intentionally permits restrained glass and violet-to-indigo gradients; do not “correct” them into flat graphite or another accent color.

rules.name: The Accent Is State Rule
rules.body: Violet marks interaction and primary completion, not ambient glow or decorative chrome.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Bricolage Grotesque throughout; do not introduce a display serif, faux-terminal mono or system-only substitute when the webfont is available.

rules.name: The Neutral Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows may separate layers, but their hue stays neutral; violet never becomes a glow.

dos: Do keep the artwork dominant and the 356px desktop panel visually self-contained.
Do preserve 28px blur, white-alpha borders and neutral elevation as one material system.
Do keep export actions visible while settings scroll.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, live status announcements and 44px mobile targets.
Do treat the Aura URL and pasted source above as the intentional visual authority.
donts: Don't split the interface into nested cards; flatten sections with dividers.
Don't replace Bricolage Grotesque with generic system typography.
Don't add chromatic shadows, neon bloom or decorative purple haze.
Don't overuse violet outside active, focused or primary states.
Don't shrink the mobile scroll target below 204px at 390×844 or let the export footer scroll away.
